clue.text: Ambitious and venomous type, one to sound off

parts.note: an asp is a venomous snake
one is the Roman numeral I
to sound off is to rant, holding forth loudly

explanation.surface: Someone describes an ambitious, venomous person who is always holding forth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ambitious' looks like an adjective, but the answer is a noun used attributively: an aspirant hopeful is ambitious.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym in attributive use: an aspiring or hopeful candidate is one with ambitions.

clue.text: Order amounts to be delivered across the course of half a day

parts.note: sums are amounts of money

parts.note: Monday is a day of the week

explanation.surface: An instruction for sums of money to be handed over within half a day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' keeps only the first half of MONDAY; 'the course of' is padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a summons is an official order to appear, as before a court.

clue.text: To get a mental grasp of real tennis, I played

definitions.text: To get a mental grasp of

indicators.note: played says the letters are reworked, like a game being played out

explanation.surface: Someone tries to master the rules of real tennis while playing it.
explanation.walkthrough: Real tennis is the old indoor court game from which lawn tennis descends.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to absorb an idea so thoroughly that it becomes part of your own thinking.

clue.text: Reef that accounts for a number getting killed

parts.note: a toll, as in death toll, is the number of people killed

explanation.surface: A reef that is blamed for many deaths at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a ring-shaped coral reef enclosing a lagoon.

clue.text: Time to get foreign currency is a bother

parts.note: the rouble is the Russian unit of currency

explanation.surface: Changing money abroad always takes a tiresome while.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: fuss or difficulty, as in 'it's no bother'.

clue.text: Dog to perform the wrong way when there's post around

parts.note: to do is to perform an action

clue.text: Hormone supporting start of life, working endlessly

parts.note: acting means working, as an acting manager

clue.text: Witchcraft of Nigerian people to the north

clue.text: Wiping out memory, spare article that's saved

explanation.surface: A spare piece of writing that has been preserved erases the memory.
explanation.walkthrough: Lethe is the river of forgetfulness in Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective from the mythical river whose water made the dead forget everything.

clue.text: Scientist's record is kept in untidy roomette

taken as written

clue.text: Horse stabled by friends or relations

clue.text: A dump with nothing left in cold US location

clue.text: Steep slope troublesome for ten campers

clue.text: Knock plant

a nation is a people
